title: Wayfare Pro Programme Terms, Part 6: Daily Cashout Limit for Established Drivers
content:
**6.1** Under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**, the instant cashouts of one calendar day, in the driver's market time, together never exceed the driver's daily cashout limit.

**6.2** The daily cashout limit follows the Wayfare Pro status recorded on the earnings account for the current quarter and the lifetime trips on the driver's driver services agreement under **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing**:

- Wayfare Pro Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite with at least 3000 lifetime trips has a daily cashout limit of 1000.00;
- Wayfare Pro Silver or Gold with at least 1000 lifetime trips has 750.00;
- any other status, or fewer lifetime trips, keeps the daily instant cashout maximum of the product's instant cashout schedule.

## Part 6.2 as a grid

| Status recorded for the current quarter | Lifetime trips on the agreement | Daily cashout limit (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite | 3000 or more | 1000.00 |
| Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite | Fewer than 3000 | The schedule's daily instant cashout maximum |
| Silver or Gold | 1000 or more | 750.00 |
| Silver or Gold | Fewer than 1000 | The schedule's daily instant cashout maximum |
| Blue | Any | The schedule's daily instant cashout maximum |

## Edges (hypothetical drivers)

| Status | Lifetime trips | Daily cashout limit |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Platinum | 3000 | 1000.00 |
| Wayfare Pro Platinum | 2999 | The schedule's daily instant cashout maximum |
| Wayfare Pro Silver | 1000 | 750.00 |
| Wayfare Pro Silver | 999 | The schedule's daily instant cashout maximum |

A Wayfare Pro Diamond driver with 1800 lifetime trips is above the 1000-trip line of Silver and Gold but below the 3000-trip line of Platinum, Diamond and Diamond Elite, and keeps the schedule's daily instant cashout maximum.

**Hypothetical figure.** A Wayfare Pro Gold driver with 1450 lifetime trips who has already cashed out 300.00 today can cash out at most 450.00 more today under the 750.00 limit.
